Class GuardrailPluginRegistry

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.guardrails.plugin.GuardrailPluginRegistry
@ApplicationScoped public class GuardrailPluginRegistry extends Object
Registry for guardrails plugins that manages discovery and retrieval of guardrail detectors.
